species.name: Pied-billed Grebe (Fall / Winter)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Stocky rounded body, warm brownish-tan face and neck with faint dusky eyeline, stubby arched chicken-like bill in pale horn (no black band), dark eye, pale fluffy undertail
species.photo_caption: Winter pond view: Stocky warm brown profile, pale horn-colored chicken bill, dark eye, solitary skulking diver
species.crux_caption: Head closeup: Stubby, strongly curved culmen; bill is plain pale horn with no dark vertical band in winter

diagnostics.mark: Short, stubby, laterally compressed arched bill resembling a domestic chicken; pale ivory-horn without black band in winter.
Warm brownish-tan cheeks and throat with faint diffuse dusky eyeline; dark brownish-black eye (never ruby-red).
Freshwater marsh edges, vegetated farm ponds, and tidal ditches; sinks slowly straight down underwater like a submarine.

species.rule_out: Stocky brown body + pale unbanded chicken bill + dark eye + solitary freshwater habit = Non-Breeding Pied-billed Grebe.

species.name: Horned Grebe (Non-Breeding / Winter)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Striking crisp black-and-white contrast: clean snow-white cheek extending squarely up to eye level, flat-topped black cap, straight dark chisel bill with pale ivory tip, ruby-red eye
species.photo_caption: Winter bay view: Crisp black-and-white head pattern, stark white cheek, brilliant ruby-red eye, straight chisel bill
species.crux_caption: Head closeup: Sharp horizontal demarcation between flat black cap and pure white cheek; ruby eye and pale bill tip

diagnostics.mark: Stark, crisp black-and-white contrast: pure snow-white cheeks cut cleanly in a straight horizontal line below the flat black cap.
Piercing brilliant ruby-red eye; straight, dark, needle-chisel bill with a distinct tiny pale ivory/yellow tip.
Crown is distinctly flat-topped with a blocky, angular nape (unlike the rounded head of Pied-billed or peaked crest of Eared).

species.rule_out: Stark snow-white cheek up to eye level + flat black cap + ruby-red eye + pale-tipped straight bill = Non-Breeding Horned Grebe.

species.name: Pied-billed Grebe (Breeding)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Diagnostic ivory-white chicken-like bill with a bold vertical black band encircling the middle, jet-black throat bib, brownish-gray body, dark eye with thin whitish eye-ring
species.photo_caption: Breeding marsh view: Bold vertical black ring encircling the pale bill, jet-black throat bib, dark brownish body
species.crux_caption: Bill & throat: Complete vertical black bar wrapped around arched ivory bill; contrasting velvety black throat patch

diagnostics.mark: Diagnostic vertical black band encircling the middle of the stout, arched, ivory-white bill.
Solid jet-black patch (bib) covering chin and upper throat, contrasting with grayish-brown head.
Dark brown eye encircled by a distinct, thin white eye-ring.

species.rule_out: Stout arched whitish bill with vertical black ring + black throat bib = Breeding Pied-billed Grebe.

species.name: Common Loon (Non-Breeding / Winter)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Large bulky low-slung body, heavy straight dagger-like bill held horizontal, dark eye surround, diagnostic jagged white notch cutting into dark neck from behind, dark scalloped mantle
species.photo_caption: Winter coastal profile: Heavy straight bill held level, jagged white notch in rear neck, dark eye surround, bulky diver
species.crux_caption: Neck & bill crux: Deep white cutout notch indenting the dark neck collar; massive stout straight dagger bill

diagnostics.mark: Diagnostic jagged white indentation or 'notch' cutting deeply into the dark collar on the side/rear of the neck.
Massive, heavy, straight dagger-like bill (grayish with pale tip), held strictly horizontal/level while swimming.
Eye is surrounded by dark plumage; crown and forehead have a steep, blocky profile with a bump over the bill base.

species.rule_out: Large bulky diver + heavy horizontal dagger bill + jagged white neck notch from behind = Non-Breeding Common Loon.

species.name: Red-throated Loon (Non-Breeding / Winter)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Slender delicate build, slender bill distinctly uptilted and held at an upward angle, extensive clean white face extending above eye and down throat, fine white speckling/dots across back
species.photo_caption: Ocean surf view: Slender bill tilted upward, extensive clean white face and foreneck, slender neck, speckled gray back
species.crux_caption: Head & bill profile: Slender bill held at diagnostic upward 15-degree tilt; culmen straight with angled lower mandible gonys

diagnostics.mark: Slender bill with an angled lower mandible, consistently held tilted upward at an elevated angle ('snobbish' posture).
Extensive clean white plumage covers the entire chin, throat, and face, extending well above and behind the eye.
Upperparts are finely spangled with tiny crisp white dots/speckles (unlike the scalloped broad scales of Common Loon).

species.rule_out: Slender uptilted bill held at an angle + extensive white face above eye + speckled white back = Non-Breeding Red-throated Loon.

species.name: Common Loon (Breeding)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Large muscular diver, iridescent black head/neck, bold striped white necklace and choker, brilliant black-and-white checkerboard mantle, heavy black dagger bill held level, ruby-red eye
species.photo_caption: Breeding plumage: Brilliant checkerboard back, striped white necklace, heavy black dagger bill, ruby-red eye
species.crux_caption: Neck & throat detail: Crisp vertical black-and-white pinstripes on neck collar; heavy chisel black bill

diagnostics.mark: Solid velvety black head/neck with green-purple sheen; striped white neck patches; spectacular black-and-white checkerboard back.
Massive, stout, entirely jet-black dagger bill held horizontal; powerful diving waterbird.
Deep glowing ruby-red eye contrasting with velvety black head.

species.rule_out: Velvet black head + striped white necklace + checkerboard back + heavy black dagger bill = Breeding Common Loon.

species.name: Horned Grebe (Breeding)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Dramatic bright golden-buff ear tufts ('horns') projecting from above eye, puffy black crested head/chin, rich chestnut-rufous neck, chest, and flanks, ruby-red eye, straight dark bill with pale tip
species.photo_caption: Spring plumage view: Brilliant golden horns, black puffy hood, rich cinnamon-rufous neck and flanks, ruby-red eye
species.crux_caption: Head closeup: Dense golden-yellow ear tufts originating over lores; black chin and crown; pale-tipped chisel bill

diagnostics.mark: Broad, brilliant golden-yellow feather tufts ('horns') starting in front of the eye and sweeping back across the dark crown.
Rich, intense chestnut-rufous foreneck, chest, and flanks (contrasting with black chin and white belly).
Straight, slender black bill with pale ivory tip; blazing ruby-red eye.

species.rule_out: Bright golden horns + black puffy hood + rich chestnut-rufous neck and flanks = Breeding Horned Grebe.

species.name: Red-necked Grebe (Non-Breeding / Winter)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Large heavy grebe (nearly twice Horned Grebe's bulk), long stout straight bill with bright yellow base and dark culmen/tip, dingy dusky-gray cheeks (never clean white), dark cap down to eye level
species.photo_caption: Winter coastal view: Large heavy build, long stout yellow-based dagger bill, dingy grayish cheek patch, dark cap
species.crux_caption: Head & bill detail: Long heavy bill with extensive bright yellow base; diffuse dirty-gray cheek (lacks Horned's crisp white)

diagnostics.mark: Long, heavy, dagger-like bill with extensive bright yellow at base and lower mandible (conspicuously heavier than Horned).
Cheeks are dingy dusky-gray with diffuse borders, blending into a whitish crescent behind ear coverts (never crisp white).
Much larger, longer-necked, and heavier-bodied than Horned Grebe; approaches loon proportions on open water.

species.rule_out: Large heavy grebe + stout yellow-based dagger bill + dingy dusky-gray cheek = Non-Breeding Red-necked Grebe.

species.name: Red-throated Loon (Breeding)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Slender uptilted bill held slightly elevated, smooth velvet slate-gray head and face, diagnostic rich triangular rufous-chestnut throat patch, fine black-and-white pinstripes down hindneck
species.photo_caption: Spring migrant view: Chestnut-red throat patch, velvety slate-gray head, pinstriped hindneck, slender uptilted bill
species.crux_caption: Throat & neck: Rich rufous-red triangular patch on foreneck; neat vertical black-and-white pinstripes on nape

diagnostics.mark: Stark triangular patch of rich, glossy chestnut-red on the center of the foreneck.
Velvety smooth slate-gray head and face; hindneck features elegant vertical black-and-white pinstripes.
Plain unspotted brownish-gray mantle; slender dark bill held tilted upward at an elevated angle.

species.rule_out: Chestnut-red throat patch + velvet slate-gray head + pinstriped hindneck + uptilted bill = Breeding Red-throated Loon.

species.name: Red-necked Grebe (Breeding)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Large crested grebe, rich warm chestnut-rufous neck and upper breast, contrasting stark silvery-white cheeks, flat black cap with slight rear crest, heavy yellow dagger bill with black culmen
species.photo_caption: Spring profile: Rich chestnut neck, stark silvery-white cheeks, black cap, heavy yellow dagger bill
species.crux_caption: Head closeup: Crisp silvery-white cheek contrasting sharply with dark cap and fiery chestnut neck; heavy yellow bill

diagnostics.mark: Rich, fiery chestnut-rufous neck and upper breast contrasting sharply with bright, clean silvery-white cheeks.
Heavy, stout dagger-like bill, bright yellow with black culmen ridge and sharp tip.
Glossy black cap with short double rear crest, cleanly separated from white cheeks.

species.rule_out: Rich chestnut neck + stark silvery-white cheeks + heavy yellow dagger bill = Breeding Red-necked Grebe.

species.name: Eared Grebe (Non-Breeding / Winter)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Distinctive peaked forehead silhouette (head highest directly above eye), slender thin slightly upturned black bill, dusky auricular smudge across ear coverts (diffuse dirty gray cheek, NOT crisp white), ruby-red eye
species.photo_caption: Review vagrant view: Peaked forehead crest over eye, thin upturned bill, dusky ear smudge across cheek, dark neck
species.crux_caption: Head silhouette: Crown peaks sharply over eye; slender bill curves slightly upward; dirty dusky wash over ear coverts

diagnostics.mark: Forehead rises steeply with peak of head directly above the eye (triangular puffy crown); bill is thin and slightly upturned.
Dusky-gray auricular smudge extends across the ear coverts; cheeks appear dirty and smudged (never clean white like Horned).
Foreneck is dusky or mottled dark gray, lacking Horned Grebe's clean white throat and foreneck.

species.rule_out: Peaked forehead crown + thin upturned bill + diffuse dusky cheek smudge = Non-Breeding Eared Grebe.

species.name: Eared Grebe (Breeding)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Peaked crested forehead, solid jet-black head, neck, and breast, spectacular fan-like spray of golden-yellow plumes radiating across cheek/ear coverts from behind eye, chestnut flanks, thin upturned bill, ruby-red eye
species.photo_caption: Breeding profile: Solid black head and neck, radiating fan of golden cheek plumes, rich chestnut flanks, peaked crest
species.crux_caption: Head closeup: Golden cheek plumes fan outward across ear coverts; black neck; thin upturned bill

diagnostics.mark: Spectacular fan-like spray of fine golden-yellow plumes radiating outward across the entire cheek from behind eye.
Solid jet-black head, chin, throat, and entire neck (unlike Horned Grebe's rufous neck).
Thin, upturned black needle bill; rich chestnut-rufous flanks and black back.

species.rule_out: Solid black neck + radiating golden cheek plumes + peaked forehead + thin upturned bill = Breeding Eared Grebe.

species.name: Western Grebe
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Large graceful swan-like structure with very long slender white neck, long sharp dagger-like greenish-yellow needle bill, solid black cap extending DOWN BELOW the bright red eye (eye in black), dark gray back
species.photo_caption: Pelagic review vagrant view: Extremely long swan-like neck, bright greenish-yellow needle bill, red eye completely surrounded by black
species.crux_caption: Head & eye crux: Black cap extends squarely below the eye so the bright red eye is completely surrounded by black (Clark's has eye in white)

diagnostics.mark: Black cap extends clearly below the eye; bright red eye is completely encircled by black plumage (unlike Clark's Grebe).
Huge grebe with an exceptionally long, slender, graceful swan-like neck (pure white in front, narrow black stripe behind).
Long, straight, sharply pointed greenish-yellow to olive dagger bill.

species.rule_out: Long swan-like neck + bright yellow needle bill + red eye completely enclosed in black cap = Western Grebe.

species.name: Pacific Loon (Non-Breeding / Winter)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Medium-sized loon structure, slender straight dagger bill held horizontal, smooth velvety silvery-ash-gray nape, clean straight demarcation line down neck, diagnostic thin dark 'chinstrap' necklace across throat
species.photo_caption: Winter coastal vagrant: Smooth velvety pale gray nape, straight razor-sharp neck demarcation, dark chinstrap line
species.crux_caption: Neck & throat detail: Diagnostic thin dark chinstrap bar across lower throat; smooth silvery nape (lacks Common Loon's neck notch)

diagnostics.mark: Nape and hindneck are smooth pale velvety silvery-gray; border between dark hindneck and white foreneck is a crisp straight line (no notch!).
Often displays a thin, neat dark brownish-gray 'chinstrap' or necklace running horizontally across the lower throat.
Slender, straight, dagger-like bill held level/horizontal (smaller and more delicate than Common Loon; not uptilted like Red-throated).

species.rule_out: Slender straight bill held level + velvety silvery-gray nape + clean straight neck demarcation + dark chinstrap = Non-Breeding Pacific Loon.
